palette_rationale: Preserve the preflight blue, white, red, black and source eye tones without guessed pupils or new face colors.
reference: Own DSTS chr055 model and native clips; PMDO registry provides names and event fields.

actions.name: Walk
actions.pose_evidence: Native short-legged running cycle; each stance is grounded from the source foot silhouette to avoid fixed-row penetration, with no duplicate endpoint.

actions.name: Attack
actions.pose_evidence: Native glove punch and forward step; physical Attack is never ground-trimmed.

actions.name: Shoot
actions.pose_evidence: Native mouth-open, fists-wide special release; no projectile or effect asset inferred.

actions.name: Sleep
actions.pose_evidence: Own long neutral/rest clip; source eyes remain open-looking, so no invented eyelids.

actions.name: Hurt
actions.pose_evidence: Native recoiling open-mouth pose, not an idle endpoint.

actions.name: Swing
actions.pose_evidence: Early source glove swing only; later native travel leaves the fixed PMDO cell and is deliberately excluded. Horizontal root X/Z is locked, preserving native deformation and Y.

actions.name: Double
actions.pose_evidence: Two native glove-punch cycles; PMDO XML exposes one HitFrame.

actions.name: Hop
actions.pose_evidence: Native acrobatic flip/lift is the distinct whole-body airborne arc; bf01 stays planted. Horizontal root X/Z locked, native Y and rotation retained.

actions.name: Charge
actions.pose_evidence: Native crouch/strain, reverse-sampled to recover; no effect invented.

actions.name: Rotate
actions.pose_evidence: Native gesture with whole-view yaw for Rotate; no duplicate endpoint.
